context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 81 validated Health Dashboard in Verwaltung tab. Key behaviors: (1) GET /api/admin/health returns {generated_at, emails, auth_refresh, maintenance, dns, users} - admin-only (403 for non-admin). (2) emails has {days=7, total, sent, failed, simulated, success_rate, by_provider, by_day, last_failure}. (3) auth_refresh has {hours=24, threshold=30, total_refreshes, top, anomalies} - anomalies list users with >30 refreshes in 24h. (10) Auto-refresh every 30s via setInterval. Regression: All iter 77 (SMTP, DNS, force-logout), iter 78 (pagination, filters), iter 80 (survey archive, templates) features still work.
